Third-party code served from this site, so no outside CDN runs code on stateq.in.

- three.js 0.169.0 (MIT): `three/build/three.module.min.js`, GLTF/DRACO loaders, BufferGeometryUtils
  and the Draco WebAssembly decoder. Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.169.0/
- GSAP 3.12.5 + ScrollTrigger (GreenSock standard license): https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.12.5/

To upgrade, download the same paths for the new version and change the version here.
